english.title: Person who is not an adoption agency or acting under High Court order take steps prohibited in section 92(2) of the Act
english.standardoffencewording: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), being neither an adoption agency nor a person acting in pursuance of an order of the High Court, took a step mentioned in section 92(2) of the Adoption and Children Act 2002, namely **(..SPECIFY STEP TAKEN..)
english.legislation: Contrary to section 93(1) and (5) of the Adoption and Children Act 2002.
english.pointstoprove:
date and location
person who is not an adoption agency / manager of adoption agency
took steps mentioned in s.92(2) to arrange adoptions

investigatoraction.description: DNA Samples: If crime scene stain present - take evidential sample If no crime scene stain and DNA not confirmed on PNC - take Criminal Justice sample. If DNA confirmed on PNC - CJ sample not required
Confirm proposed charge is appropriately authorised (Police or CPS)
Ensure compliance with investigator's obligations re disclosure
Consider if case suitable for referral to Financial Investigation Unit and CPS for asset recovery eg confiscation order

english.notes:
(i) If the person is an adoption society, the person who manages the society is also guilty of the offence
(ii) Section 92(3) and (4) outlines conditions applicable to some of the prohibited steps which are allowable
(iii) A person is not guilty of an offence of taking the step mentioned in section 92(2)(f) unless it is proved that he knew or had reason to suspect that the child was handed over to him in contravention of section 92(2)(e) of the Act - section 93(2)
(iv) A person is not guilty of an offence of causing a person to take any of the steps in section 92(2)(a) to (h) of the Act unless it is proved that he knew or had reason to suspect that the step taken would contravene the paragraph in question - section 93(3)
(v) Sections 93(2) and (3) only apply if sufficient evidence is adduced to raise an issue as to whether the person had the knowledge reason mentioned
english.standardstatementoffacts: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) the defendant, being neither an adoption agency nor a person acting in pursuance of an order of the High Court, took a step mentioned in section 92(2) of the Adoption and Children Act 2002, namely **(..SPECIFY STEP TAKEN..).

other.penalty:
Summary: Imprisonment for a term not exceeding six months and / or a fine not exceeding £10,000.

Time limit for prosecutions
6 months

On the 12th March 2015 the limit on fines imposed by a Magistrates court was removed – as such, the potential fine on summary conviction in relation to an offence committed after this date is unlimited.
